values.policy.privacy.title: Privacy notice
values.policy.privacy.body:
Visitor records. This site uses an essential visitor cookie and an IP-derived network identifier to remember used flights, including after refresh. The server records page views, button interactions, stake changes, round starts, cashouts and completed results in a database. IP addresses are converted to keyed hashes for matching.

Admin access. Logged-in administrators have a separate, time-limited session cookie and can replay for testing. Admin activity is recorded separately. No payment details are requested by this page. Google Fonts receives normal connection information when fonts load.

Your choices. Clearing browser data removes local cookies but does not reset server-recorded chances. Visitors sharing a network may share the two-flight limit. Contact contact@kixo9.com with privacy questions. Operator identity and a published retention policy must be supplied before a public campaign launches.
values.policy.terms.title: Terms of this demo
values.policy.terms.body:
Adults only. Use this experience only if you are 18 or older and meet the legal age requirement where you live.

Virtual play. This is a scripted, two-flight demonstration. The balance, activity feed and results are simulated. No deposit, purchase, withdrawal or prize of real-world value is available here.

No prediction or entitlement. Demo results do not represent real game odds or guarantee future outcomes. Playing creates no entitlement to a KIXO9 bonus. Any separate promotion needs its own published eligibility and complete terms.
values.policy.responsible.title: Keep play in balance
values.policy.responsible.body:
For adults of legal age. Take regular breaks and set limits on your time. Gambling should never be treated as income or a solution to financial problems.

Know the difference. This demo uses scripted outcomes and virtual credits. Its results do not predict real-money play. Never chase losses or play with money needed for essentials.

Need support? If play stops feeling enjoyable, stop and seek help. Visit Gambling Therapy (https://www.gamblingtherapy.org/) for international support and guidance.
values.policy.cookies.title: Cookies & browser storage
values.policy.cookies.body:
Essential cookies. The k9_visitor cookie identifies this browser for up to one year. The k9_admin cookie identifies an authenticated administrator for up to 12 hours. These are HttpOnly, SameSite cookies; secure transmission is enabled on HTTPS.

Server records. Used chances and game actions are recorded on the server. Clearing cookies or refreshing does not restore chances on the same network. The CMS also stores unsaved editor drafts locally in the admin browser.

Advertising and analytics. When a Google Tag Manager container is configured, it can load the advertising and analytics tags selected by the site operator. Those tags may use cookies or process interaction data according to their configuration.
values.policy.promotion.title: 500% welcome bonus
values.policy.promotion.body:
The KIXO9 welcome offer. A 500% welcome bonus is advertised for eligible new players. Adults of legal age only. Availability depends on your location and the operator’s eligibility rules.

Check the full offer before depositing. Deposit requirements, bonus caps, wagering requirements, game restrictions, withdrawal limits and expiry are governed by KIXO9’s current promotion terms. Those detailed conditions have not been supplied for this landing page.

Separate from the demo. Virtual winnings here cannot be withdrawn or exchanged for this offer. Continue to KIXO9 (https://www.kixo9.com/signup) to review the offer before participating.
values.help.0.title: Set your stake
values.help.0.body: Use the − / + buttons or quick chips (₹100, ₹200...) to choose your bet amount for the round.
values.help.1.title: Launch the round
values.help.1.body: Tap "Take Off" to start a simulated round with your virtual stake.
values.help.2.title: Watch it climb
values.help.2.body: The multiplier starts at 1.00x and climbs higher into the stratosphere as the flight progresses.
values.help.3.title: Cash out in time
values.help.3.body: Tap the cash-out button before the plane flies away to secure your win. If it flies away first, the round is lost.
values.help.4.title: Practice with virtual credits
values.help.4.body: The activity feed and both flights are simulated. Credits cannot be withdrawn, and demo results do not predict real-money outcomes.
values.help.title: How to Play Aviator
values.tour.0.title: Set your stake
values.tour.0.body: Tap − or + to choose how much rides on the round.
values.tour.1.title: Launch the round
values.tour.1.body: Hit 'Take Off' to place your stake and launch the flight.
values.tour.2.title: Watch it climb
values.tour.2.body: The multiplier starts at 1.00x and speeds up as it rises.
values.tour.3.title: Cash out in time
values.tour.3.body: Tap the same button mid-flight. Too late and the bet is gone.
values.tour.4.title: Practice, not prediction
values.tour.4.body: Both flights and the activity feed are simulated. Credits have no cash value.
